title: The Role of JNK and p53 in the Regulation of Secretory Function of Neuroglial Cells of Various Types in beta-Amyloid-Induced Neurodegeneration.
authors: Zyuz'kov, G N; Miroshnichenko, L A; Chaikovskii, A V; Kotlovskaya, L Yu
journal: Bulletin of experimental biology and medicine
one_liner_zh: 该文研究JNK和p53抑制剂对β-淀粉样诱导神经退行中神经胶质细胞分泌神经营养因子的影响，完全不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、转录因子结合或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: We studied the effect of JNK and p53 inhibitors on the production of neurotrophic factors stimulating the realization of the growth potential of neural stem cells by neuroglial cells of various types under conditions of simulation of induced beta-amyloid neurodegeneration in vitro. It was shown that beta-amyloid stimulates the production of neurotrophins by astrocytes and microglial cells, but does not affect the functioning of oligodendrocytes. JNK and p53 were not involved in the secretion of neurotrophins by intact astrocytes. The stimulating role of p53 on the implementation of their secretory activity under the influence of a neurotoxic agent was revealed. At the same time, the inhibitory role of JNK and p53 in the production of neurotrophic growth factors by oligodendrocytes and microglial cells was revealed both under conditions of their optimal vital activity and when beta-amyloid was added to the cell culture.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了在体外模拟诱导β-淀粉样蛋白神经退行性变条件下，JNK和p53抑制剂对各类神经胶质细胞产生神经营养因子（刺激神经干细胞生长潜力实现）的影响。结果表明，β-淀粉样蛋白刺激星形胶质细胞和小胶质细胞产生神经营养因子，但不影响少突胶质细胞的功能。JNK和p53未参与完整星形胶质细胞的神经营养因子分泌。在神经毒性因子作用下，揭示了p53对其分泌活性实现的刺激作用。同时，在少突胶质细胞和小胶质细胞的最佳生命活动条件下以及向细胞培养物中添加β-淀粉样蛋白时，均揭示了JNK和p53对其神经营养生长因子产生的抑制作用。
